description: Source code for WifiManagerWPS class implementation, handling Wi-Fi Protected Setup (WPS) operations such as initiate, cancel pairing, save/clear SSID, and retrieve paired SSID info within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: WifiManagerWPS
classes.description: Class implementing Wi-Fi WPS management functions within the plugin.

methods.name: initiateWPSPairing
methods.description: Starts WPS pairing process via IARM bus call.

methods.name: cancelWPSPairing
methods.description: Cancels ongoing WPS pairing via IARM bus call.

methods.name: saveSSID
methods.description: Saves SSID, passphrase, and security mode to the device.

methods.name: getPairedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of the currently paired network.

methods.name: getPairedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info (SSID and BSSID) of the paired network.

methods.name: isPaired
methods.description: Checks if the device is currently paired.
